column1: # The Linux layer's LC3 root (plans/linux-compat.md, "The Linux root"): a subset of the minimal
# lock of LC0, the closure of Depends and Pre-Depends of libc6, dash, coreutils, findutils, grep,
# tar, gzip and base-files. Each line is copied from that lock, which lists the package index's
# SHA-256 for the file; the index is named by the signed InRelease below.
